Leaflet is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2026 to 2026.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1) and [Media and art](@/projects/media.md) (1).

Most recently: [openttd-prismatic-bridge](@/work/openttd-prismatic-bridge.md): REST/Swagger bridge onto OpenTTD's Admin Network, for prismatic-platform; [Crisis map](@/work/crisis-map.md): Reports geocoded through a local Nominatim, stored as PostGIS geography and served from one capability registry: LiveView, REST, OpenAPI, MCP and CLI.

1 of these projects runs as a live site.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Leaflet: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Leaflet to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
